featureUnavailable.title: This part of PMO isn't on your plan
featureUnavailable.body: Your organisation’s plan does not include {{feature}}. Nothing has been deleted — an administrator can switch it back on.
featureUnavailable.errorTitle: We couldn't check what's on your plan
featureUnavailable.errorBody: The plan and switch settings did not load. Try again; if it keeps failing, ask your administrator.

yourPlan.intro: This page is read-only. Your organisation’s plan and its switches are set by the PMO operator — ask them to change a plan or switch a feature on.
yourPlan.deniedBody: Your plan is visible to the organisation’s administrator.
yourPlan.loadFailed: Your plan could not be loaded
yourPlan.loadFailedBody: Try again; if it keeps failing, ask your administrator.

console.organisationHelper: Every switch below is this organisation’s resolved state.
console.planHelper: Plan limits: {{seats}} seats, {{projects}} active projects, {{messages}} AI messages a month.
console.planHelperUnassigned: No plan row: this organisation resolves as Enterprise.
console.switchesCaption: Effective switch state, its source, the plan default, the per-organisation override and the all-organisations switch.
console.planDefaultsHelper: These are the values an organisation without an override inherits.
console.limitsHelper: Leave a field blank for unlimited / per contract.
console.coreRefused: Core modules and the Admin-owned switch can't be changed here.
console.unknownRef: That organisation or plan no longer exists.
console.planSavedBody: The organisation now resolves that plan’s switches.
console.clearedBody: The switch follows the plan again.
console.globalOnBody: Every organisation can use this switch again.
console.globalOffBody: Every organisation loses it, whatever its plan or override.
console.limitsSavedBody: New organisations on this plan inherit them.
console.loadFailed: The plan registry could not be loaded
console.loadFailedBody: Nothing was changed. Try again; if it keeps failing, the registry read is unavailable.
console.globalConfirmTitle: Switch this off for every organisation?
console.globalConfirmBody: {{feature}} will be off for every organisation, whatever its plan or override. Data is kept; switching it back on restores it.
